usedFor: Vyte holds the scheduled events, LeadConnector receives the person, and “Event Is Confirmed” can start “Create Or Update Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “Event Is Confirmed” in Vyte, then “Create Or Update Contact” in LeadConnector
bestTemplate.why: A confirmed event adds the contact, or updates it if it already exists in LeadConnector.

watchOut: “Event Is Updated” fires on every change, so “Create Contact” can duplicate a person; “Create Or Update Contact” avoids that.
